name: T.R.V. Rubber Products Public Company Limited
summary: T.R.V. Rubber Products Public Company Limited operates as a specialized manufacturer and supplier of diverse molded rubber components. Its extensive product range significantly serves the automotive sector, offering crucial parts such as shock-absorbing rubber hoses, vehicle-specific rubber cables, various gaskets, O-rings, rubber spheres, sealing elements, rubber materials for brake pads, and anti-skid floor mats. Furthermore, the company fabricates tailored rubber components for a wide array of electrical appliances, including those found in rice cookers, water pumps, washing machines, vacuum cleaners, microwave ovens, compressors, refrigerators, and air filtration systems. Beyond these applications, T.R.V. also provides specialized molded rubber parts for other industries, including agricultural machinery and plumbing installations. The company was founded in 1996 and its main operations are based in Bangkok, Thailand.
